# Floor

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Math](Language-Features-Math)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Floor:Float32 float:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `float` | In | Float32 | required | The number to round down. |

**Returns:** The largest whole number that is not above `float`.

## Description

Rounds down to the previous whole number and returns it as a float.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Floor(2.9)
Print Floor(-2.1)
```

```text
2.0
-3.0
```
